[[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Factions quest)]] (if Warrior not primary profession) | profession = Warrior | primary = y | secondary = n }} Having completed fundamental Warrior training, meet with Togo for further instructions. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Warrior | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Return to the monastery. * Seek out Master Togo in Linnok Courtyard. ===Reward=== * 600 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Open your world map (default: "M"), and click on [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into [[Linnok Courtyard]]. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Weng Gha ''Your defeat of the crop thieves has proven your courage and honor. It is time now for you to take the next step on your jouney. [[Master Togo]] wishes to meet with you in [[Linnok Courtyard]] just off of the main monastery proper.'' ''Use your map to travel there quickly.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm on my way. | decline = I need to rest, first. | ask = You are ready to become a Warrior, . Use your map to return to the monastery. [[Master Togo]] awaits you in [[Linnok Courtyard]]. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Master Togo ''Headmaster Zhan has told me great thing about you, . You have begun to learn the way of the Warrior, but to reach your full potential you must choose a second path.'' '' Speak with the other headmasters and learn what they have to teach you. When you are ready to make a final choice, come and speak to me again.'' {{sic}} ==Notes== *The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player, once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the followup quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
